fixture.normalization: Test-harness-only SQLite transaction renumbers unindexed generated atoms before refresh; it preserves indexed IDs and verifies foreign keys before commit.

method_notes: Each benchmark invocation creates an isolated temporary vault, ingests generated metadata, then measures refresh and recall in child processes.
Storage snapshots are taken after child exit; WAL is normally zero at those points. Transient peak WAL size is not sampled.
RSS is the maximum of sequential helper and CLI child processes during that run, not recall-only RSS.
No performance claim is based on the earlier unnormalized exploratory runs; all 12 formal runs use deterministic IDs.
